description: This course covers software quality assurance principles and practices, including defect classification using ISO 25010, requirements traceability matrix (RTM) creation with DOORS, test case design using equivalence partitioning and boundary value analysis, and defect tracking with JIRA. Students will explore software metrics such as cyclomatic complexity and defect density, and learn to apply ISO 9001 standards for quality management. The course also includes automated testing with Selenium and JMeter for load testing, and software reviews using IEEE 1028 standards. Topics include quality planning, process improvement with CMMI, and risk analysis techniques such as failure mode and effects analysis (FMEA).
